svg.title: Residual Stress Hub — printed RS
svg.desc: Three-dimensional RS joined directly to a thick blue build plate, without supports. R has a continuous red-to-white-to-blue gradient matching the title palette from top to bottom, with the white transition at three-quarters of its height. S is solid medium gray with subtle metallic face shading. Both letters have approximately 30 printed layers following their front and side faces; the build plate stays smooth.
